title: The Evolution of Digital Transformation: History From Pre-Internet to Generative AI | HatchWorks AI
description: Explore the fascinating journey of digital transformation, from its pre-internet roots to the current era of generative AI. Understand the key milestones, evolving technologies, and how digital transformation has reshaped business models, customer experiences, and organizational processes. Discover how staying competitive in today’s market hinges on embracing continuous digital evolution.
